items.title: Iran attacks Gulf energy assets raise fears for Strait of Hormuz shipping
items.summary: Missile and drone strikes across Gulf energy infrastructure heightened fears of disruption to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and raised concern over LNG and helium exports tied to Qatar and Saudi industrial flows.
